propositions: Prior audit (bleakish-stational-cob) proposed six process improvements must be evaluated against existing decisions, janitor work, and implementation outcomes before conversion to work tickets

Escaped-defect metadata (detected_by) was implemented as optional fail-open capture at creation seams and achieved 1.1% coverage; proposal should expand automated stamping at known filer boundaries, not mandate global field or backfill history

Deterministic plan preflight currently enforces P1-P11 mechanical conditions; proposals for extension must demonstrate recurrent failure classes in persisted review data, meet false-positive ceilings, and complete offline replay validation before promotion

Completion-failure classification requires offline historical analysis to distinguish code defects from unmet ACs, missing evidence, plan gaps, environment errors, and verifier failures before adding durable schema codes

Risk-tiered review must pilot without merge enforcement; evaluation should measure defect/revert rates by signal tier (security surfaces, file impact, complexity, diff breadth) before setting blocking thresholds

Proactive debt management 720 LOC warning is already deployed; future work should target concrete clone families and near-cap complexity intersections, not arbitrary duplication quotas or full population drains
